title: DRUM Task Group Approved for 2025–2027 Term
summary: The 34th CODATA General Assembly officially approved the renewal of the Digital Representation of Units of Measurement (DRUM) Task Group for the upcoming two-year term.

title: DRUM Session at SciDataCon 2025
summary: DRUM hosted a panel discussion on 'FAIR Units of Measurement: Successes and Roadblocks' at SciDataCon 2025, bringing together representatives from multiple scientific unions.

title: Nature Commentary Advocates for Machine-Readable Units
summary: The DRUM task group published an editorial comment in Nature outlining the critical importance of digital units to prevent data squandering.
